import { expectTypeOf, test } from 'vitest'
import type {
  AnswerMalformed,
  ContentDefect,
  DegradedReason,
  EffectUnknown,
  EndpointBodyRejection,
  KeptReason,
  ListingDefect,
  LostReason,
  NoAnswerCause,
  NotSentReason,
  OperationFailure,
  ProtocolFault,
  Refusal,
  UnavailableReason,
} from '@omne-harness/mcp-contract'
import type {
  EligibilityVerdict,
  TransportFailure,
  WithheldReason,
} from '@omne-harness/mcp-contract/provider'
import type { CLOSED_SETS } from './closed-sets.ts'

type Members<K extends keyof typeof CLOSED_SETS> = (typeof CLOSED_SETS)[K][number]

test('each code list has exactly the members of its type', () => {
  expectTypeOf<Members<'EndpointBodyRejection'>>().toEqualTypeOf<EndpointBodyRejection>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'ListingDefect'>>().toEqualTypeOf<ListingDefect>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'UnavailableReason'>>().toEqualTypeOf<UnavailableReason>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'ContentDefect'>>().toEqualTypeOf<ContentDefect>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'ProtocolFault'>>().toEqualTypeOf<ProtocolFault['kind']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'NoAnswerCause'>>().toEqualTypeOf<NoAnswerCause>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'Refusal'>>().toEqualTypeOf<Refusal['kind']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'NotSentReason'>>().toEqualTypeOf<NotSentReason['kind']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'KeptReason'>>().toEqualTypeOf<KeptReason['kind']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'OperationFailure'>>().toEqualTypeOf<OperationFailure['kind']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'EffectUnknown'>>().toEqualTypeOf<EffectUnknown['cause']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'AnswerMalformed'>>().toEqualTypeOf<AnswerMalformed['what']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'TransportFailure'>>().toEqualTypeOf<TransportFailure['kind']>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'DegradedReason'>>().toEqualTypeOf<DegradedReason>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'LostReason'>>().toEqualTypeOf<LostReason>()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'EligibilityVerdict'>>().toEqualTypeOf<
    Extract<EligibilityVerdict, { kind: 'refused' }>['reason']
  >()
  expectTypeOf<Members<'WithheldReason'>>().toEqualTypeOf<WithheldReason>()
})

import { expectTypeOf, test } from 'vitest'
import type * as Provider from '@omne-harness/mcp-contract/provider'

// The type exports of `./provider`, each named once.
type ProviderTypes = {
  AdoptedEndpoint: Provider.AdoptedEndpoint
  AdoptionView: Provider.AdoptionView<unknown, unknown>
  CallRequest: Provider.CallRequest
  CatalogStore: Provider.CatalogStore
  CredentialFailure: Provider.CredentialFailure
  CredentialPurpose: Provider.CredentialPurpose
  CredentialUse: Provider.CredentialUse<unknown>
  EligibilityVerdict: Provider.EligibilityVerdict
  HttpCredentialHandle: Provider.HttpCredentialHandle
  HttpPurpose: Provider.HttpPurpose
  ListingPage: Provider.ListingPage
  McpTransport: Provider.McpTransport
  McpTransportFactory: Provider.McpTransportFactory
  ProcessCredentialHandle: Provider.ProcessCredentialHandle
  ProcessEnvironment: Provider.ProcessEnvironment
  ProcessHandle: Provider.ProcessHandle
  ProcessLanding: Provider.ProcessLanding<unknown>
  ProcessPurpose: Provider.ProcessPurpose
  ProcessSetting: Provider.ProcessSetting
  SentCall: Provider.SentCall
  TaskAnswer: Provider.TaskAnswer
  TransportFailure: Provider.TransportFailure
  TransportMaterial: Provider.TransportMaterial
  UseEligibility: Provider.UseEligibility<unknown>
}

test('./provider exports the port types and no value', () => {
  // A removed or renamed type fails to compile above. An added one is caught by the export-name
  // tests in public-entry.spec.ts, which read the entry source with regular expressions: they
  // list named exports, report star exports, and refuse any form but `export type { … } from`.
  expectTypeOf<ProviderTypes['CredentialUse']>().not.toBeNever()
  expectTypeOf<keyof typeof import('@omne-harness/mcp-contract/provider')>().toEqualTypeOf<never>()
})

/**
 * The source text of a module without comments and empty statements. A mutation sandbox adds a
 * `// @ts-nocheck` header and stray `;` statements; neither is an import or an export.
 */
function sourceOf(file: string): string {
  return withoutNoise(readFileSync(new URL(`../src/${file}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8'))
}

function withoutNoise(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//gu, '')
    .replace(/(^|[^:'"])\/\/[^\n]*/gu, '$1')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(line => line.trim() !== '' && line.trim() !== ';')
    .join('\n')
}

/**
 * The relative modules that a source file imports or re-exports, in either quote style, through
 * `from`, a bare `import` or a dynamic `import()`.
 */
function relativeImports(text: string): readonly string[] {
  const pattern = /(?:\bfrom\s*|\bimport\s*\(?\s*)(["'])\.\/([^"']+)\1/gu
  return [...text.matchAll(pattern)].flatMap(match => (match[2] === undefined ? [] : [match[2]]))
}

/** The source files that an entry reaches through relative imports. */
function reached(entry: string): ReadonlySet<string> {
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const pending = [entry]
  for (let file = pending.pop(); file !== undefined; file = pending.pop()) {
    if (seen.has(file)) continue
    seen.add(file)
    for (const target of relativeImports(sourceOf(file))) pending.push(target)
  }
  return seen
}

it('the root and provider entries do not reach the testing modules', () => {
  for (const entry of ['index.ts', 'provider.ts']) {
    const files = [...reached(entry)]
    expect(files.length).toBeGreaterThan(1)
    expect(files.filter(file => file.startsWith('testing'))).toEqual([])
  }
})

it('no source file imports an MCP SDK or Cordis', () => {
  const files = [...reached('index.ts'), ...reached('provider.ts'), ...reached('testing.ts')]
  for (const file of new Set(files)) {
    expect(sourceOf(file)).not.toMatch(/["']@modelcontextprotocol\/|["']@deepseek-ai\/cordis/u)
  }
})

it('reads relative imports in either quote style and form', () => {
  const text = [
    "import { a } from './single.ts'",
    'export { b } from "./double.ts"',
    "import './bare.ts'",
    'const c = await import("./dynamic.ts")',
    "import { d } from '@omne-harness/other'",
  ].join('\n')
  expect(relativeImports(text)).toEqual(['single.ts', 'double.ts', 'bare.ts', 'dynamic.ts'])
})

/**
 * The names an entry exports. Star exports (`export *`, `export type *`) cannot be listed by
 * name, so they come back as `*`; `export { type X }` counts as a name too.
 */
function exportedNames(text: string): readonly string[] {
  const stars = [...text.matchAll(/\bexport\s+(?:type\s+)?\*/gu)].map(() => '*')
  const named = [...text.matchAll(/\bexport\s+(?:type\s+)?\{([^}]*)\}/gu)]
    .flatMap(match => (match[1] ?? '').split(','))
    .map(name => name.trim().replace(/^type\s+/u, ''))
    .filter(name => name !== '')
  return [...stars, ...named].sort()
}

/** Every export statement of an entry, from `export` to the end of the statement. */
function exportStatements(text: string): readonly string[] {
  return [...text.matchAll(/\bexport\b[^;]*?from\s*['"][^'"]+['"]|\bexport\b[^\n]*/gu)].map(
    match => match[0],
  )
}

it('reads star exports and inline type names as exports', () => {
  const text = [
    "export type * from './a.ts'",
    "export * from './b.ts'",
    "export { type C, D } from './c.ts'",
    "export type { E } from './e.ts'",
  ].join('\n')
  expect(exportedNames(text)).toEqual(['*', '*', 'C', 'D', 'E'])
})

it('the provider entry exports exactly the port type names', () => {
  expect(exportedNames(sourceOf('provider.ts'))).toEqual(PROVIDER_TYPES)
})

it('a not-sent (session-ended) of the provider entry carries no mark but session-ended (T1)', () => {
  const ended: TransportFailure = {
    kind: 'not-sent',
    cause: 'session-ended',
    unusable: 'session-ended',
  }
  const wrong: TransportFailure = {
    kind: 'not-sent',
    cause: 'session-ended',
    // @ts-expect-error only T8 S07 gives an ended session, and it ends the transport for session-ended
    unusable: 'process-exited',
  }
  expect([ended.kind, wrong.kind]).toEqual(['not-sent', 'not-sent'])
})

it('the provider entry uses only the export type { … } from form', () => {
  const statements = exportStatements(sourceOf('provider.ts'))
  expect(statements.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  for (const statement of statements)
    expect(statement).toMatch(/^export type \{[^}]*\} from (["'])\.\/[^"']+\1;?$/u)
})

it('reads a module the way a mutation sandbox writes it', () => {
  const text = withoutNoise(
    [
      '// @ts-nocheck',
      '/* export * from "./hidden.ts" */',
      ';',
      "export type { A } from './a.ts'; // export * from './b.ts'",
      ';',
    ].join('\n'),
  )
  expect(exportedNames(text)).toEqual(['A'])
  expect(exportStatements(text)).toEqual(["export type { A } from './a.ts'"])
})
